summary: Cohen & Co Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry and termination of material agreements. The company's operating subsidiary amended and restated a senior promissory note originally issued to JKD Capital Partners I LTD, owned by a board member and his spouse. The amended note totals $5.0 million, combining the unpaid original amount plus additional principal, maturing August 31, 2027, with 10% annual interest paid quarterly. This refinancing of related-party debt is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. Watch for continued related-party dealings and default triggers, but no structural event like an acquisition or tender is present.
